headline: 10 Michigan deals, $20.4M raised — led by Michigan State University Federal Credit Union

top_deals.company: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union
top_deals.summary: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union, an East Lansing-based financial services company, filed a $15M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $15M sold to 3 investors.
Tricap Btr Fund II LLC, an Ann Arbor-based investment fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $2.2M sold to 11 investors.
BSF Howell Holdings LLC, a Birmingham-based commercial real estate company, filed a $2M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.9M sold to 7 investors.
Golden Hour LLC, an Okemos-based company, filed a $500K equity offering under Rule 506(b); $500K sold.
BSF Howell Holdings II, LLC, a Birmingham-based commercial real estate company, filed a $445K equity offering under Rule 506(b); $431.2K sold to 7 investors.

new_funds.summary: Tricap Btr Fund II LLC, an Ann Arbor-based investment fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $2.2M sold to 11 investors.

notable_ma.summary: Markel Group Inc. reported a 39.6% stake in Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 7).
Hagerty Holding Corp. reported a 51.4% stake in Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 4).

material_agreements.summary: Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) entered into a material definitive agreement (debt offering).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $20.4M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 60% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Michigan State University Federal Credit Union (East Lansing, Other Banking and Financial Services) targeting $15M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $2.2M raised so far — led by Tricap Btr Fund II LLC (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Hagerty Holding Corp. reported a 51.4% stake in Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 4). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
